g.text: SYNC marks let a subscriber merge the lane
channels with the step channel exactly
MBO is split by lane: 4 lane channels (lane L goes to k = L mod 4) and one step channel (index 4).
the lane-op records after it (up to the next SYNC) are ordered after
step T and before step T+1. Emitted lazily, only before the first
every record of channel k ordered before step W_k + 1 is in this
apply step T only when W_k ≥ T − 1 for every k.
before step T, apply every pending lane-op record whose
SYNC position is < T, in any order across channels.
